description: Deploy a container image as a Fargate service on the resource group's OWN ECS cluster (isolated from the platform control plane). Optionally attach to the shared ALB - left at the default path it's served at /<serviceName>/* so it never collides with the platform UI - and forward logs to S3.
estimatedMonthlyCost: ~$9/mo per always-on 0.25vCPU/512MB task; +Firehose if log forwarding on. The per-group ECS cluster itself is free.
